title: Save the tables of a Grammar Guide's query blocks
description: Runs each motif query corpus forms block of a Grammar Guide section, or of every section, read-only and stages its saved table in a Draft: a caption and the first ten rows, stored right after the block as an ordinary FieldWorks table, so FieldWorks shows it without Motif. Only this command and the window's Save table write a table; Motif always shows a recomputed result. Nothing reaches the FieldWorks project until a person applies the Draft. Available in Advanced AI mode.
